action: Trigger buy button click event via Selenium/JavaScript
expected_observation: Observe cart addition request and DOM reaction
actual_observation: Clicking button.btn-buy executes internal browser AJAX submission to cart session. Badge counter increments without full page reload.
notes: Internal browser AJAX action within active Yii2 session. Not a public REST API. Requires 2.0-2.5s post-click settle time.
